_comment: How a blizzard climbs the tiers, dial by dial (notes/instability-tiers-plan.md, design 5.2).
Difficulty you can answer: light stops the snow settling and leather stops the freezing -- both
vanilla's own rules. Three dials are weather and unsettle: `often` (how often a storm comes), `long`
(how long each lasts) and `visibility` (how close the whiteout closes in, and how hard the snow drifts),
each turning hazardous only at its far end. `frostbite` is how fast the cold gets into anyone out in it,
which is the one that kills, so it is hazardous throughout.
Leans cold, and never shares an Age with an inferno (Jonah, 2026-10-12).
